description.value: Yunqueen Rice Noodles (七彩云南) is a Yunnan-style Chinese restaurant on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End, specializing in traditional rice noodle dishes anchored by slow-simmered Golden Guoqiao broth and Classic Small Pot noodles made fresh to order. Beyond noodles, the menu spans cold Yunnan dishes, braised duck neck, goose feet, and seasonal salads that reflect the bold regional flavors of Yunnan province. Touring cyclists on the Robson Street corridor will find a warm, sit-down spot for a substantial and restorative meal.
